description: Omaha, NE — Tonight, in the first of three debates between the candidates running to represent Nebraska’s Second Congressional District, frontrunner Denise Powell made it clear that she is the only leader prepared to go to Washington to get things done for Nebraskans – while Brinker Harding struggled to articulate his vision while running away from his ties to Donald Trump.

title: Powell Wins Debate: As Harding Struggles to Run Away from Trump, Powell Provides Clear Plans to Lower Costs for Nebraskans - Denise Powell for Congress
